Poison Arrow.name: Poison Arrow
Poison Arrow.description:
No immediate damage. If hit target rolls a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs}. On a failure, the target takes [[/r 2d6dmg#Poison Damage]]{2d6 Damage} directly.

Does not affect inorganic targets.
